title: 贝蕾亚·暮光石窗
description: 浅色短发贝蕾亚披完整酒红外衣，静立高石窗前，标志木枷轮廓与红眼清晰，神情平静坚定。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Briar is a pale adult young woman with short uneven white-lavender hair, striking pink-red eyes, pointed ears, and a distinctive curved wooden restraint frame around her shoulders. Preserve these identity anchors without distress, frightening spikes, or predatory expression. Dress her in a fully covering maroon tunic, opaque trousers, wrapped shoes, and a substantial dark cape, keeping natural adult comic proportions.
art_direction.scene: Show her standing still beside a tall open stone window, hands relaxed in front of her body and gaze directed into the distance. The wooden frame remains clear and comfortable, with no struggle. A single hard sunset beam illuminates her pale hair and wine-red cloth; decisive wax-crayon hatching and receding plain wall planes provide strength without horror.
art_direction.palette: pale lilac, burgundy, charcoal, copper sunset
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
